name: FV_SAM_ACCOUNT_ADDRESS_SETS
description: This table stores information about Account Address Set and Customer Account assignment for a SAM Trading Partner.

columns.description: Unique identifier of the SAM customer account address set assignment.

columns.name: SET_ID

columns.name: PREVIOUS_BILL_TO_SITE_USE_ID

columns.name: INSTRUMENT_PAYMENT_USE_ID

columns.name: RECORD_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Single-character code that defines the status of the record as Unprocessed (U), Processed (P), or Error (E).

columns.name: SAM_PROCESS_JOB_ID
columns.description: Enterprise service scheduler: indicates the job ID of the SAM process job that created or updated this record.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
